gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the $40–70 C50i supports LDAC too, using the same SBC/AAC/LDAC codecs as the AeroClip 2. Soundcore's own C50i FAQ also says that turning LDAC on switches off dual connection (multipoint), and LDAC is Android-only, so iPhone users get AAC on both.
standout_why: I compared against the cited soundcore.com AeroClip 2 and C50i product pages, the Soundcore clip-on collection page, the Soundcore 'AeroClip vs AeroClip 2' blog, our own dealectric.com/soundcore-aeroclip-2-vs-c50i page, and the uncited SoundGuys C50i spec page. The C50i product page lists no codecs. The blog covers only the AeroClip models and has no C50i. All three ChatGPT answers present LDAC as a reason to pay for the AeroClip 2. Our own page lists LDAC for the AeroClip 2 and only '6.0, multipoint' for the C50i, and names LDAC among the things the extra money buys. Only SoundGuys, ranked 7–10 and never cited, lists LDAC for the C50i. None of the pages says that LDAC turns off multipoint or that LDAC does nothing on an iPhone. Rivals have part of the finding, so this scores 2 and not 3.
decides: This backs the C50i as the value pick and removes one of the AeroClip 2's claimed music advantages. LDAC is the same on both. An iPhone owner gets AAC from either model. An Android owner who wants LDAC on the C50i gives up two-device connection while it is on. The AeroClip 2's real hardware differences are the call microphones, IP57 and a wireless-charging case, the last per two named reviewers. LDAC should come out of the AeroClip 2's advantages on our page. We should also fix our C50i Bluetooth cell, which currently reads '6.0, multipoint' with no LDAC.

findings.label: Supported codecs (maker FAQ)
findings.note: Q: 'Which audio codecs does soundcore C50i support?' A: 'SBC, AAC, LDAC'.

findings.label: Limit stated by the maker: LDAC vs dual connection
findings.value: Dual connection (multipoint) is not available while LDAC is on
findings.note: Verbatim: 'Dual connection is not supported when using LDAC. Please disable LDAC and enable the dual connection function.' The same FAQ says pairing a second device is blocked during a call, and that only one device streams audio (A2DP) at a time, with a 3–5 s switch.

findings.value: SBC / AAC / LDAC; Bluetooth 6.0; case input 5 V / 0.9 A
